findings.claim: Repository-local validator acceptance is not established by supplied verdict-grade evidence.

findings.rationale: The goal requires that the manifest be accepted by the repository-local validator and no longer report an invalid provenance manifest. Without canonical validator evidence, that required outcome cannot be verified; task prose and stdout are not verdict data.
